name: KROHNE UFC 400 (ultrasonic flow converter) Modbus RTU
model: UFC 400 signal converter for ultrasonic flowmeters (Modbus, ER 2.2.0 / Modbus 2.1.0)
doc_revision: KROHNE 05/2013 - 4002744801 - AD Modbus UFC 400 R01 en; electronic revision ER 2.2.0, Modbus version 2.1.0
notes: Addressing: the manual states the converter uses protocol addresses (example: input register 30006 has start address 30006 = 0x7536), so address_base=0 and the listed numbers are used unchanged (FC04 for the 3xxxx/20000+ input registers, FC03/16 for 4xxxx/5xxxx holding registers, FC01/05 for coils at 0..9999, FC02 for discrete inputs 10000+). Note the unusual ranges: holding registers go up to 52023. Default RS485 settings (menu C5.8): address 1, 19200 bps, even parity, 1 stop bit, big endian (matches the connection block). Multi-register values (float, double, long) follow the 'Register Format' setting (50006); this preset assumes Big Endian (word_order big). Configuration written to holding registers only takes effect after 'Apply Changes' (coil 1002) and can be dropped with 'Discard Changes' (1003). The manual's holding-register tables use merged 'Type' cells; the totaliser 'Time constant / Set or read value / Preset' and the process-input 'Time constant' rows are modelled as float32 because their register stride is 2 (type cell not repeated). 'Long' (baud rate, NE 107 groups) is modelled as unsigned 32 bit (signedness not stated). Totaliser 3 (modular-carrier converters only) and the C1.x calibration constants (GK, limitation min/max, dynamic viscosity, plausibility) are not included. Deliberately left out as dangerous: coil 1000 Restart Device, coil 1004 Reset to Factory Data, coil 2000 Zero Calibration Start (the manual says only trained service engineers should zero-calibrate). Documented as plain register writes but they affect the measurement/accounting: totaliser resets, set value, low-flow cut-off, flow direction, density, apply changes. NE107 event-group status registers 52017-52023 and the 'Zero calibration result' input register were not modelled.

points.name: Totaliser 1 Value (double)
points.note: Unit m3 or kg depending on the 'Measurement' selection of the totaliser (40001/40003).

points.name: Totaliser 1 Value (float)
points.note: Single precision copy of the same value.

points.name: Totaliser 2 Value (double)
points.note: Unit m3 or kg depending on the 'Measurement' selection of the totaliser (40001/40003).

points.name: Totaliser 2 Value (float)
points.note: Single precision copy of the same value.

points.name: Unsaved Changes
points.note: Discrete input 10001 (FC02).

points.name: Totaliser 1 Run
points.note: Coil 3000: write 0 stop / 1 start; read returns status. Stopping a totaliser affects accounting.

points.name: Totaliser 1 Reset
points.note: Coil 3003: write 1 to set the totaliser value to zero. DESTROYS THE ACCUMULATED TOTAL.

points.name: Totaliser 2 Run
points.note: Coil 3001: write 0 stop / 1 start; read returns status. Stopping a totaliser affects accounting.

points.name: Totaliser 2 Reset
points.note: Coil 3004: write 1 to set the totaliser value to zero. DESTROYS THE ACCUMULATED TOTAL.

points.name: Reset Errors
points.note: Coil 1001: write 1 clears the system error flags.

points.name: Apply Changes
points.note: Coil 1002: write 1 to apply holding-register configuration changes (required before they take effect). Applying changes can change the measurement.

points.name: Discard Changes
points.note: Coil 1003: write 1 to discard unapplied changes.

points.name: Totaliser 1 Function
points.note: Needs 'Apply Changes' (coil 1002) to take effect.

points.name: Totaliser 1 Measurement
points.note: Value 1 is not defined. Needs 'Apply Changes'.

points.name: Totaliser 2 Function
points.note: Needs 'Apply Changes' (coil 1002) to take effect.

points.name: Totaliser 2 Measurement
points.note: Value 1 is not defined. Needs 'Apply Changes'.

points.name: Totaliser 1 Low Flow Cut-Off
points.note: Unit m3/s or kg/s depending on the totaliser measurement. Needs 'Apply Changes'.

points.name: Totaliser 1 Time Constant
points.note: Documented range 0...100 s. The type column of the manual is merged for this row group: float (2 registers) inferred from the 2-register address stride.

points.name: Totaliser 1 Set or Read Value

points.name: Totaliser 1 Preset

points.name: Totaliser 2 Time Constant

points.name: Totaliser 2 Set or Read Value
points.note: Unit m3 or kg. Writing sets the totaliser value - AFFECTS THE ACCUMULATED TOTAL. Float type inferred from the register stride.

points.name: Totaliser 2 Preset
points.note: Unit m3 or kg. Float type inferred from the register stride.

points.name: Flow Direction
points.note: Needs 'Apply Changes'.

points.name: Linearization
points.note: Needs 'Apply Changes'.

points.name: Time Constant
points.note: Display function C1.3.3. Needs 'Apply Changes'. Type not stated in the merged table cell; float inferred from the 2-register stride.

points.name: Low Flow Cutoff Threshold
points.note: Needs 'Apply Changes'. Affects the measurement.

points.name: Low Flow Cutoff Hysteresis
points.note: Needs 'Apply Changes'. Affects the measurement.

points.name: Density
points.note: Used for the mass flow calculation.

points.name: Baud Rate
points.note: Long (2 registers). Documented values 1200, 2400, 3600, 4800, 9600, 19200 (default), 38400, 57600, 115200. Writing drops the connection. Needs 'Apply Changes'.

points.name: Slave Address
points.note: Default 1. Writing moves the device off the current address.

points.name: Register Format
points.note: Byte/word order of ALL multi-register values. This preset assumes big endian (1). The manual's little-endian layout mixes byte positions and cannot be expressed here.
